notes.title: "LIGHT" difficulty and new treasures discovered
notes.content:
Thank you for always driving Tawashi.

We have new information from Tawashi World.


 "LIGHT" difficulty found
 New treasures found
 The contents of the result "ALL" were incorrectly repaired
 Minor bugs have been repaired


The following information is for pilots who control Tawashi by touch or mouse operation.


 Added MOVE TYPE option to lower score instead of speeding up your Tawashi


* If you feel that Tawashi's movement is slow by touch operation, please select the "Fingertip + SPD up / PTS down" icon on the setting screen. Speed ​​up Tawashi and decrease your score. (This setting is not recommended because it greatly changes the characteristics of the game)

Good Luck

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content:
Thank you for enjoying the Tawashi.

There was a bug in the game, so I fixed it. Please update and enjoy.

 Fixed a bug where some treasure achievements could not be achieved.
